facts.text: The Wind River Promise Fund covers the full cost of undergraduate tuition and mandatory fees for Wyoming residents who are enrolled members of the Eastern Shoshone Tribe or Northern Arapaho Tribe.

sources.title: University of Wyoming Newe & Hinono'ei Scholarship
sources.quote: The Wind River Promise Fund is intended to cover the full cost of undergraduate tuition and mandatory fees, contingent upon available funds*.

sources.title: University of Wyoming Newe & Hinono'ei Scholarship
sources.quote: Be an enrolled member of the Eastern Shoshone Tribe or the Northern Arapaho Tribe.

sources.title: University of Wyoming Newe & Hinono'ei Scholarship
sources.quote: Be a Wyoming resident who graduated from a Wyoming high school or accredited boarding school.
